hope: Spend 3 Hope to temporarily Distract a target within Close range: -2 to their Difficulty.

features.name: Rally
features.short: Once per session, give yourself and each ally a Rally Die (d6; d8 at level 5). A PC can spend it to roll and add the result to an action, reaction or damage roll, or to clear that many Stress. Clear unspent Rally Dice at session end.

bard.troubadour.name: Gifted Performer
bard.troubadour.short: Describe your performance to play each song once per long rest: Relaxing (you and allies within Close range clear a Hit Point), Epic (a target within Close range is temporarily Vulnerable), Heartbreaking (you and allies within Close range gain a Hope).
Maestro. When you give an ally a Rally Die, they can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
Virtuoso. Perform each Gifted Performer song twice per long rest.

bard.wordsmith.name: Rousing Speech
bard.wordsmith.short: Once per long rest, give a speech: all allies within Far range clear 2 Stress.

bard.wordsmith.name: Heart of a Poet
bard.wordsmith.short: After an action roll to impress, persuade, or offend, spend a Hope to add a d4.

Eloquent. Once per session, when you encourage an ally, choose one: they find a mundane object or tool they need; Help an Ally without spending Hope; or they get an additional downtime move next rest.
Epic Poetry. Your Rally Die is a d10. When you Help an Ally, you can narrate it as the tale of their heroism and roll a d10 as your advantage die.
